appErrorsDescription: Recent render failures captured by the app-router error boundaries. Sentry remains the long-term archive; this is the in-app mirror.

errorsUnavailableBody: Your platform role does not include the console.read permission.
emptyNoMatchBody: Try a different route or message substring. The search is case-insensitive.
emptyNoErrorsBody: Render failures captured by the app-router error boundaries will appear here. The mirror is in-app; Sentry is the long-term archive.
explainerBody: Every row was captured by an app-router error boundary. The digest is the Next.js error digest (stable across retries). The request id links to the structured log line for the same request. The build is the commit SHA at the time of capture. For the full payload (sourcemaps, breadcrumbs, full stack) open the matching event in Sentry.

emptyAgenciesBody: Platform bootstrap creates the singleton agency on first run. If this list is empty in production, check the bootstrap endpoint.
investigateHelp: Need to investigate a specific agency? Open its

accessDescription: Assign operational responsibilities without granting tenant content. Support access remains ticketed, approved, time-limited, and separately audited.
signInRequiredAccessBody: Sign in to view platform access.
accessUnavailableBody: Your platform role does not include access oversight.
readOnlyAccessOversightBody: You can review assignments and audit history. Only a Platform Owner can change access.
ownerWarning: There is only one active Platform Owner. Add a second owner before changing or revoking this assignment. The server prevents removal of the final owner.
addMemberDescription: The person must have signed in once. Choose the narrowest role that matches their responsibility; every change requires a reason and is audited.
currentAssignmentsDescription: Platform roles control the global console only. They do not make someone an agency or workspace member.
emptyAssignmentsBody: Recover access with the documented production bootstrap procedure.

auditEmptyBody: Future platform role changes will appear here.

securitySignInBody: Sign in to access the platform security console.
securityUnavailableBody: Your platform role does not include audit oversight or support access.
securityDescription: Ticketed, approved, time-limited access to tenant content. Every view through an active grant is audited.
securityActiveGrantsDescription: The time-bound grants you currently hold. A grant unlocks tenant content for the listed scope; the audit log records every view.
securityEmptyGrantsBody: File a support access request from the agency detail page to get started.
securityAuditDescription: The latest platform-wide support audit summaries. Tenant content is never included.
securityRecentViewsDescription: The last 50 audit rows where you are the viewer. Only action, target type, and outcome are shown.
securityEmptyRecentViewsBody: Tenant views you make through an active grant appear here.
securityRequestsDescription: Pending support access requests across every agency. Agency admins decide from the agency detail page.
securityEmptyRequestsBody: No agency has a pending support access request right now.
cronSignInBody: Sign in to view the platform cron health page.
cronUnavailableBody: Your platform role does not include the console.read permission.
cronDescription: Heartbeat of every cron that writes to cron_tick_history. The 15-min social-metrics cron is the headline card; the rest follow the same pattern.
cronEmptyBody: The cron routes write one row per tick to cron_tick_history. After the next 15-minute tick lands, this page will populate.
cronLogTailDescription: Newest first across every active cron. Each row is one tick; the outcome column is the raw enum (success / soft_deadline / error / skipped).
cronLogTailEmptyBody: Once a cron ticks, the latest row will appear here.
cronExplainerBody: Every cron route (/api/cron/social-metrics, /api/cron/outbox, etc.) writes one row to cron_tick_history at the end of every tick — success, soft deadline, flag-off short-circuit, or exception. The last-tick dot is green when the age is within 2× the cron's expected cadence, amber inside 4×, red beyond that. Retention is 30 days (CRON_TICK_RETENTION_DAYS).
cronSparklineAria: Claim count over the last {count} ticks
cronRunNowHelp: Trigger a synchronous social-metrics tick. Audit-logged.

lifecycleArchiveBodyAction: The agency will leave normal operations. Tenant data is preserved, and only a Platform Owner can reverse this action.
